title: Lakshya Sen Suffers Shock Exit at World Championships, Sindhu and Ayush Advance
indian_angle: This report details the mixed fortunes of India's top shuttlers at the BWF World Championships, highlighting a significant upset for Lakshya Sen.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This news highlights the preparation of India's young talent for upcoming international junior championships, crucial for the future of Indian badminton.
